spans.s:
m. (-कः)
1 A frog.
2 A cloud.
f. (-की)
1 The female of the frog, or a small frog.
2 A kind of creeper, (Hydrocotyle Asiatica.)
E.
भी to fear, Uṇādi aff. कन्.

f. (-र्णी)
A creeper, (Hydrocotyle Asiatica.)
E.
भेक a frog, and पर्ण a leaf; resembling the animal.

m. (-क्)
A serpent, a snake.
E.
भेक, and भुज who eats.
